name: inspira-lens
title: Lens Magnifier
description: A wrapper that adds a circular magnifying lens over its child. Moving the pointer drags the zoomed circle around; leaving the image makes it fade away.
use: Product, map or artwork detail needs a closer look without opening a lightbox.
avoid: It duplicates the child content for the zoom, so it suits one image, not heavy interactive children.
a11y: The magnifier is pointer-only, so keyboard users get no zoom, and the lens ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: no, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide mountain landscape sits inside a rounded rectangle. Under the cursor a circular patch shows the same scene at twice the size, with a soft translucent rim, while the rest stays at normal scale.
behaves: Moving the pointer across the image carries the magnified circle with it. It fades and shrinks in on entry, then fades out when the pointer leaves the frame.
customise: zoomFactor, lensSize and position are props, plus isStatic, hovering and onHoverUpdate to drive it externally; children supply the content.
weight: light: One extra scaled copy of the children and a short enter animation.
